heading.zh-Hant: 出身、早年與州政府司法職務
heading.en: Origins, early career and state justice office

body.zh-Hant: 華盛頓·路易斯1869年10月26日生於里約熱內盧州馬卡埃，1891年自聖保羅法學院畢業，此後主要在聖保羅州從事職業與政治活動，因此得到「馬卡埃的聖保羅人」之稱。1897年他當選巴塔塔伊市議員，1898至1899年主持該市市政。1904年他以共和黨（PRP）名義當選州議員，1906年被任命為州司法廳長，任職至1912年。
body.en: Washington Luís was born in Macaé, Rio de Janeiro state, on 26 October 1869 and graduated from the São Paulo law school in 1891. He then worked mainly in São Paulo state, hence the nickname 'paulista de Macaé'. In 1897 he was elected a councillor of Batatais, and in 1898-1899 he headed the municipal administration there. In 1904 he was elected a state deputy under the legend of the Partido Republicano Paulista (PRP), and in 1906 he was appointed state Secretary of Justice, a post he held until 1912.

heading.en: Mayor of São Paulo and state president

body.zh-Hant: 1912年9月他再度以PRP名義當選州議員。1914年1月14日聖保羅市議員推選他為市長，他中斷議員任期就任，1919年把職位交給副市長。市長任內設立自由市集，並在市徽加入「Non ducor, duco」的格言。1920年3月1日他當選聖保羅州長，約兩個月後就職，任職至1924年。
body.en: In September 1912 he was again elected a state deputy under the PRP legend. On 14 January 1914 the city councillors chose him as mayor of São Paulo; he took office, interrupting his parliamentary mandate, and in 1919 he handed the post to the deputy mayor. During his term the free street markets were instituted and the motto 'Non ducor, duco' was added to the city's coat of arms. He was elected head of the state government of São Paulo on 1 March 1920, took office about two months later and served until 1924.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、總統、流亡與晚年
heading.en: Senator, president, exile and final years

body.zh-Hant: 1925至1926年他任聖保羅州的聯邦參議員，1926年起出任共和國總統，任期至1930年。1930年革命中，接管權力的軍人委員會於11月3日把權力交給瓦加斯。他其後流亡歐洲與美國，在國外一直待到1947年，同年9月18日返抵里約熱內盧，之後隱退，專心歷史研究。他於1957年8月4日在聖保羅去世。
body.en: From 1925 to 1926 he was a senator for São Paulo, and from 1926 he was president of the Republic until 1930. During the 1930 revolution the military junta that had taken power handed it to Getúlio Vargas on 3 November. He went into exile in Europe and the United States, stayed abroad until 1947 and was received in Rio de Janeiro on 18 September of that year; he then withdrew from public life to historical studies. He died in São Paulo on 4 August 1957.

heading.zh-Hant: 法律出身與雷克雅維克警察局長
heading.en: Legal training and Reykjavík police chief

body.zh-Hant: 約納松是冰島政治家，進步黨（Framsóknarflokkurinn）成員，受過法律訓練，並曾在數個北歐國家研究警政與犯罪問題。他出任雷克雅維克警察局長，至1934年卸任；起任年份兩份來源不一，丹麥的 Lex 記1929年，挪威的 Store norske leksikon 記1928年。
body.en: Jónasson was an Icelandic politician of the Progressive Party (Framsóknarflokkurinn), trained as a lawyer, who studied police and criminal questions in several Nordic countries. He was police chief of Reykjavík until 1934; the sources disagree on the start year, Lex giving 1929 and Store norske leksikon giving 1928.

studerte politi- og kriminalspørsmål i flere nordiske land

heading.zh-Hant: 進入議會與戰前、戰時首相
heading.en: Entering the Althing and prime ministership

body.zh-Hant: 1934年他當選阿爾庭議員（代表進步黨），同年出任首相，組成與社會民主黨的聯合政府。冰島總理府名單記他自1934年7月28日起任首相，第一段至1941年11月18日，並於同日起再任至1942年5月16日。1939年起他領導全國性聯合政府，在大戰爆發與1940年英軍占領冰島期間扮演關鍵角色。
body.en: In 1934 he was elected to the Althing for the Progressive Party and became prime minister the same year, in a coalition government with the Social Democrats. The Icelandic Prime Minister's Office lists him as prime minister from 28 July 1934 to 18 November 1941, and again from 18 November 1941 to 16 May 1942. From 1939 he led a national coalition government and played a decisive role around the outbreak of the Second World War and the British occupation of Iceland from 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 1944至1962年他擔任進步黨主席。1945年他成為最高法院律師，1950至1953年任農業部長，1956至1958年再度出任首相。他於1967年離開阿爾庭。
body.en: From 1944 to 1962 he was chairman of the Progressive Party. He became a Supreme Court attorney in 1945, served as minister of agriculture in 1950-1953 and was prime minister again in 1956-1958. He left the Althing in 1967.

body.zh-Hant: 保羅·艾申1841年生於迪基希，父親夏爾－熱拉爾·艾申（Charles-Gérard Eyschen）是地方法院院長。他先就讀盧森堡雅典中學，後來在巴黎、波昂與柏林學習法律。他於1866年當選時年僅25歲；普法戰爭期間，他參加盧森堡的救護隊，前往色當與梅茨戰場救助傷兵。
body.en: Paul Eyschen was born in Diekirch in 1841; his father, Charles-Gérard Eyschen, was president of the district court. He attended the Athénée de Luxembourg and then studied law in Paris, Bonn and Berlin. He was elected in 1866, when he was only 25 years old; during the Franco-Prussian War he served in the Luxembourgish rescue parties that went to the battlefields of Sedan and Metz to help wounded soldiers.

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、駐德代辦與司法職務
heading.en: Deputy, envoy to Germany and justice office

body.zh-Hant: 艾申自1866年起是議員。1875至1888年他派駐德國政府，來源記為公使（GND）或代辦（盧森堡市府頁）。1876年他加入費利克斯·德·布洛豪森的內閣，擔任司法與公共工程總局長，並直接參與拆除要塞與城市發展。
body.en: Eyschen was a deputy from 1866. From 1875 to 1888 he served at the German government, described as envoy (GND) or chargé d'affaires (City of Luxembourg page). In 1876 he joined Félix de Blochhausen's ministry as director-general of Justice and Public Works and played a direct role in the dismantling of the fortress and the urban development of the city.

heading.en: Minister of State and foreign affairs, 1888-1915

body.zh-Hant: 1888年起，艾申擔任盧森堡的首相（國務大臣）並兼管外交，直到1915年去世，任期長達二十七年以上，至今仍是該國首相任期最長者。他在1899與1907年的海牙會議上為中立國的立場辯護。歷史學者斯庫托（Denis Scuto）指出，1902年盧森堡已提前把與德國的關稅同盟與鐵路協定續約到1959年。
body.en: From 1888 until his death in 1915 Eyschen led Luxembourg as prime minister (minister of state) and also handled foreign affairs, for more than twenty-seven years, still the longest tenure in that post. At the Hague Conferences of 1899 and 1907 he pleaded the cause of neutral countries. The historian Denis Scuto notes that in 1902 Luxembourg had already renewed, ahead of time, its customs union and railway convention with Germany until 1959.
